picture.alt: Outside a building with blue-framed glass doors, on a sunny paved path with green bushes behind a railing, four young people stand close together. In the middle, a young man with black hair, an open sage-green shirt over a red striped T-shirt, black trousers and a backpack strap holds up a photo in one hand and points at it with the other, smiling and talking. The photo shows a food stall: a red canopy, yellow paper lanterns, a cook in a white cap and blue clothes behind trays of round snacks, and a red-and-white striped front. At the front on the left, a girl with short wavy dark hair, round glasses and freckles, a white collared shirt, a purple vest, green trousers and a white backpack leans forward with her hands together under her chin, smiling at the photo. Behind her stands a person with long wavy brown hair, a mustard-yellow sweater vest over a purple shirt and a dark green backpack, one finger at the chin, looking at the photo. On the right, a girl with long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings, a bright blue shirt over an orange top, white trousers and a black backpack holds her hands together near her chin and smiles at the young man. Nobody is holding a camera.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 中間的男生在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 中间的男生在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Zhōngjiān de nánshēng zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the young man in the middle doing?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài tānzi shàng mài xiǎochī.
choices.english: He is selling snacks at a stall.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He is taking a photo of his friends.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā ná zhàopiàn gěi péngyǒu kàn.
choices.english: He is showing his friends a photo.

questions.why: The young man in the middle holds up a photo and points at it while his friends look. The stall and its cook are only inside the photo, and nobody has a camera.

picture.alt: An evening show outdoors: string lights, a dark blue sky, lit windows of a building and white tents in the back. On a wooden stage with warm lights and a big drum, a young man with black hair, a dark blue jacket with white diamond patterns on the sleeves, a white T-shirt, a teal sash and black trousers dances with one arm up and the other stretched out, smiling. Behind him on the left stands a second young man in the same blue jacket and teal sash, playing a bamboo flute held to the side. In front of the stage, the audience claps: a girl with long wavy dark hair, gold hoop earrings and a blue shirt; a girl with round glasses, a white collar and a purple vest; and a young man with curly blond hair in a teal jacket, all smiling and clapping. In the foreground, the backs of more heads and raised clapping hands.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 看表演的人在做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 看表演的人在做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Kàn biǎoyǎn de rén zài zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What are the people watching the show doing?

questions.why: The audience in front of the stage claps. Dancing and playing the flute are what the two young men on the stage do.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 文化日在大禮堂舉辦，離宿舍太遠了，我們坐公車去吧，要不然叫計程車也可以。
lines.simplified: 文化日在大礼堂举办，离宿舍太远了，我们坐公车去吧，要不然叫计程车也可以。
lines.pinyin: Wénhuàrì zài dà lǐtáng jǔbàn, lí sùshè tài yuǎn le, wǒmen zuò gōngchē qù ba, yàobùrán jiào jìchéngchē yě kěyǐ.
lines.english: Culture Day is in the big auditorium. It's too far from the dorm; let's take the bus, or else a taxi.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 遠？近得很！從宿舍後門走過去，十分鐘就到了。等公車要等半天，計程車又太貴。
lines.simplified: 远？近得很！从宿舍后门走过去，十分钟就到了。等公车要等半天，计程车又太贵。
lines.pinyin: Yuǎn? Jìn dehěn! Cóng sùshè hòumén zǒu guòqù, shí fēnzhōng jiù dào le. Děng gōngchē yào děng bàntiān, jìchéngchē yòu tài guì.
lines.english: Far? It's really close! From the dorm's back gate it's a ten-minute walk. The bus takes ages to come, and a taxi costs too much.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那騎腳踏車呢？
lines.simplified: 那骑脚踏车呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà qí jiǎotàchē ne?
lines.english: What about cycling?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 禮堂旁邊沒有地方停車啊。
lines.simplified: 礼堂旁边没有地方停车啊。
lines.pinyin: Lǐtáng pángbiān méiyǒu dìfāng tíngchē a.
lines.english: There's nowhere to park by the auditorium.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的覺得他們應該怎麼去？
prompt.simplified: 男的觉得他们应该怎么去？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de juéde tāmen yīnggāi zěnme qù?
prompt.english: How does the man think they should get there?

questions.why: 遠？近得很！ rejects 'too far': it is very close, ten minutes on foot from the back gate. He turns down the bus (a long wait), the taxi (too expensive) and the bike (nowhere to park).

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 文化日還有三個星期，我想報名表演吹笛子。你學過笛子，你覺得三個星期學得會嗎？
lines.simplified: 文化日还有三个星期，我想报名表演吹笛子。你学过笛子，你觉得三个星期学得会吗？
lines.pinyin: Wénhuàrì hái yǒu sān ge xīngqí, wǒ xiǎng bàomíng biǎoyǎn chuī dízi. Nǐ xué guo dízi, nǐ juéde sān ge xīngqí xué de huì ma?
lines.english: Culture Day is three weeks away, and I'd like to sign up to play the flute. You've learned the flute. Do you think I can learn it in three weeks?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 學得會？難得很！我學了半年，到現在連一首歌都還吹不好。
lines.simplified: 学得会？难得很！我学了半年，到现在连一首歌都还吹不好。
lines.pinyin: Xué de huì? Nán dehěn! Wǒ xué le bàn nián, dào xiànzài lián yì shǒu gē dōu hái chuī bù hǎo.
lines.english: Learn it? It's really hard! I've studied it for half a year and still can't play a single song well.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這樣啊……那我還是去擺攤子，介紹我們國家的小吃好了。
lines.simplified: 这样啊……那我还是去摆摊子，介绍我们国家的小吃好了。
lines.pinyin: Zhèyàng a…… nà wǒ háishì qù bǎi tānzi, jièshào wǒmen guójiā de xiǎochī hǎo le.
lines.english: I see… Then I'll set up a stall and introduce my country's snacks instead.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de sān ge xīngqí xué bú huì.
choices.english: The woman can't learn it in three weeks.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Chuī dízi bàn nián jiù xué de huì.
choices.english: The flute can be learned in half a year.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā dízi chuī de hěn búcuò.
choices.english: He plays the flute quite well.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Nǚ de yīnggāi qù bǎi tānzi.
choices.english: The woman should set up a stall.

questions.why: 學得會？難得很！ answers her question with 'very hard': after half a year he still can't play one song well, so three weeks won't be enough for her. Half a year didn't make him good either, and the stall is her own new plan, not his advice.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 下個月的世界文化日，你們班打算做什麼？
lines.simplified: 下个月的世界文化日，你们班打算做什么？
lines.pinyin: Xià ge yuè de Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, nǐmen bān dǎsuàn zuò shénme?
lines.english: What is your class planning for next month's World Culture Day?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 得看有多少人報名。滿十個人，我們就表演跳舞；不到十個，就擺個攤子，介紹我們國家的傳統玩具。
lines.simplified: 得看有多少人报名。满十个人，我们就表演跳舞；不到十个，就摆个摊子，介绍我们国家的传统玩具。
lines.pinyin: Děi kàn yǒu duōshǎo rén bàomíng. Mǎn shí ge rén, wǒmen jiù biǎoyǎn tiàowǔ; bú dào shí ge, jiù bǎi ge tānzi, jièshào wǒmen guójiā de chuántǒng wánjù.
lines.english: It depends on how many people sign up. With ten we'll do a dance; with fewer than ten we'll set up a stall and show our country's traditional toys.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 現在有幾個人報名了？
lines.simplified: 现在有几个人报名了？
lines.pinyin: Xiànzài yǒu jǐ ge rén bàomíng le?
lines.english: How many have signed up so far?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來只有七個，不過剛剛又有三個同學來報名了。
lines.simplified: 本来只有七个，不过刚刚又有三个同学来报名了。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái zhǐyǒu qī ge, búguò gānggāng yòu yǒu sān ge tóngxué lái bàomíng le.
lines.english: There were only seven, but three more classmates have just signed up.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 他們班最後要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 他们班最后要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Tāmen bān zuìhòu yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What will their class do in the end?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Qī ge rén yìqǐ bǎi tānzi.
choices.english: Run a stall with seven people.

questions.why: 得看有多少人報名: ten people means a dance, fewer means a toy stall. Seven had signed up and three more just did, which makes ten, so they will dance.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 這個星期六晚上的演唱會，你會去嗎？
lines.simplified: 这个星期六晚上的演唱会，你会去吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqíliù wǎnshàng de yǎnchànghuì, nǐ huì qù ma?
lines.english: Are you going to the concert on Saturday evening?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 本來得看餐廳要不要我去打工。要打工的話，我十點才能下班。
lines.simplified: 本来得看餐厅要不要我去打工。要打工的话，我十点才能下班。
lines.pinyin: Běnlái děi kàn cāntīng yào bú yào wǒ qù dǎgōng. Yào dǎgōng dehuà, wǒ shí diǎn cái néng xiàbān.
lines.english: It depended on whether the restaurant needed me at work. If I work, I can't leave until ten.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那現在呢？
lines.simplified: 那现在呢？
lines.pinyin: Nà xiànzài ne?
lines.english: And now?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 老闆剛剛打電話來，說那天還是要我去，不過讓我八點就下班。
lines.simplified: 老板刚刚打电话来，说那天还是要我去，不过让我八点就下班。
lines.pinyin: Lǎobǎn gānggāng dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō nà tiān háishì yào wǒ qù, búguò ràng wǒ bā diǎn jiù xiàbān.
lines.english: The boss just called: he still needs me that day, but he will let me leave at eight.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 演唱會七點半開始，你一下班就過來吧！
lines.simplified: 演唱会七点半开始，你一下班就过来吧！
lines.pinyin: Yǎnchànghuì qī diǎn bàn kāishǐ, nǐ yí xiàbān jiù guòlái ba!
lines.english: The concert starts at half past seven. Come over as soon as you finish work!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的大概什麼時候會到演唱會？
prompt.simplified: 男的大概什么时候会到演唱会？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de dàgài shénme shíhòu huì dào yǎnchànghuì?
prompt.english: About when will the man get to the concert?

questions.why: 本來得看……: it depended on work, and working meant finishing at ten. Now he still works but leaves at eight, so he arrives a little after eight. Half past seven is when the concert starts, and ten was the old finishing time.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你明天就要去日本了，行李都準備好了嗎？護照放進去了沒有？
lines.simplified: 你明天就要去日本了，行李都准备好了吗？护照放进去了没有？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ míngtiān jiù yào qù Rìběn le, xínglǐ dōu zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma? Hùzhào fàng jìnqù le méiyǒu?
lines.english: You're leaving for Japan tomorrow. Is your luggage all ready? Have you packed your passport?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 護照？我前天帶去銀行換錢，回來就放在書桌上了。要不是妳問，我明天一定上不了飛機！
lines.simplified: 护照？我前天带去银行换钱，回来就放在书桌上了。要不是你问，我明天一定上不了飞机！
lines.pinyin: Hùzhào? Wǒ qiántiān dài qù yínháng huàn qián, huílái jiù fàng zài shūzhuō shàng le. Yàobúshì nǐ wèn, wǒ míngtiān yídìng shàng bù liǎo fēijī!
lines.english: My passport? I took it to the bank to change money the day before yesterday and left it on my desk when I got back. If you hadn't asked, I'd never have got on the plane tomorrow!

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那你快去拿吧！
lines.simplified: 那你快去拿吧！
lines.pinyin: Nà nǐ kuài qù ná ba!
lines.english: Then go and get it, quick!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā chàyìdiǎn qù bù liǎo yínháng.
choices.english: He almost couldn't get to the bank.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他差一點把行李弄丟了
choices.simplified: 他差一点把行李弄丢了
choices.pinyin: Tā chàyìdiǎn bǎ xínglǐ nòng diū le.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā chàyìdiǎn wàng le dài hùzhào.
choices.english: He almost forgot to take his passport.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā chàyìdiǎn mǎi bú dào jīpiào.
choices.english: He almost couldn't get a plane ticket.

questions.why: 要不是妳問，我明天一定上不了飛機: if she hadn't asked, he would have left the passport on his desk and couldn't have flown. The bank visit went fine, and nothing happened to his luggage or ticket.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 新來的那位同事，以前在美國住了十年。
lines.simplified: 新来的那位同事，以前在美国住了十年。
lines.pinyin: Xīn lái de nà wèi tóngshì, yǐqián zài Měiguó zhù le shí nián.
lines.english: That new colleague lived in America for ten years.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 難怪他的英文那麼好！上次開會，外國客人說什麼，他都聽得懂。
lines.simplified: 难怪他的英文那么好！上次开会，外国客人说什么，他都听得懂。
lines.pinyin: Nánguài tā de Yīngwén nàme hǎo! Shàng cì kāihuì, wàiguó kèrén shuō shénme, tā dōu tīng de dǒng.
lines.english: No wonder his English is so good! At the last meeting he understood everything the foreign clients said.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 是啊，所以老闆常常要他陪外國客人吃飯。
lines.simplified: 是啊，所以老板常常要他陪外国客人吃饭。
lines.pinyin: Shì a, suǒyǐ lǎobǎn chángcháng yào tā péi wàiguó kèrén chīfàn.
lines.english: Yes, so the boss often has him take foreign clients to dinner.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 那位同事的英文為什麼那麼好？
prompt.simplified: 那位同事的英文为什么那么好？
prompt.pinyin: Nà wèi tóngshì de Yīngwén wèishénme nàme hǎo?
prompt.english: Why is that colleague's English so good?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He often looks after foreign clients.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā zài Měiguó zhù guo hěn jiǔ.
choices.english: He lived in America for a long time.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā cháng gēn wàiguó kèrén kāihuì.
choices.english: He often has meetings with foreign clients.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Tā de kèrén dōu shì Měiguó rén.

questions.why: 難怪 joins the cause to the result: he lived in America for ten years, no wonder his English is so good. Taking foreign clients out is what the boss asks of him because his English is good, not why it is good, and only one meeting is mentioned.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 每天早上在操場慢跑的那位老先生，你知道他幾歲嗎？
lines.simplified: 每天早上在操场慢跑的那位老先生，你知道他几岁吗？
lines.pinyin: Měi tiān zǎoshàng zài cāochǎng mànpǎo de nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng, nǐ zhīdào tā jǐ suì ma?
lines.english: Do you know how old that old man is who jogs on the sports field every morning?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 他跑得那麼快，大概六十歲吧？
lines.simplified: 他跑得那么快，大概六十岁吧？
lines.pinyin: Tā pǎo de nàme kuài, dàgài liùshí suì ba?
lines.english: He runs so fast. About sixty?

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他今年八十五了，每天都跑五公里呢！
lines.simplified: 他今年八十五了，每天都跑五公里呢！
lines.pinyin: Tā jīnnián bāshíwǔ le, měi tiān dōu pǎo wǔ gōnglǐ ne!
lines.english: He's eighty-five this year, and he runs five kilometers every day!

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 真的嗎？我一點都看不出來。
lines.simplified: 真的吗？我一点都看不出来。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ yìdiǎn dōu kàn bù chūlái.
lines.english: Really? I'd never have guessed.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的是什麼意思？
prompt.simplified: 男的是什么意思？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de shì shénme yìsi?
prompt.english: What does the man mean?

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他以為老先生跑得很慢
choices.simplified: 他以为老先生跑得很慢
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi lǎo xiānshēng pǎo de hěn màn.
choices.english: He thought the old man ran slowly.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他以為老先生年紀比較小
choices.simplified: 他以为老先生年纪比较小
choices.pinyin: Tā yǐwéi lǎo xiānshēng niánjì bǐjiào xiǎo.
choices.english: He thought the old man was younger.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他覺得老先生跑得太多
choices.simplified: 他觉得老先生跑得太多
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde lǎo xiānshēng pǎo de tài duō.
choices.english: He thinks the old man runs too much.

choices.speaker: N
choices.traditional: 他覺得老先生應該多休息
choices.simplified: 他觉得老先生应该多休息
choices.pinyin: Tā juéde lǎo xiānshēng yīnggāi duō xiūxí.
choices.english: He thinks the old man should rest more.

questions.why: 看不出來 means he couldn't tell by looking: he guessed sixty, but the man is eighty-five, so he took him for much younger. He said the old man runs fast, and he never says the running is too much.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 表演已經開始了，你怎麼還在門口走來走去？
lines.simplified: 表演已经开始了，你怎么还在门口走来走去？
lines.pinyin: Biǎoyǎn yǐjīng kāishǐ le, nǐ zěnme hái zài ménkǒu zǒu lái zǒu qù?
lines.english: The show has already started. Why are you still pacing up and down at the door?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我在等我的室友。半個小時以前，他就說快到了，可是到現在還沒看到他。
lines.simplified: 我在等我的室友。半个小时以前，他就说快到了，可是到现在还没看到他。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài děng wǒ de shìyǒu. Bàn ge xiǎoshí yǐqián, tā jiù shuō kuài dào le, kěshì dào xiànzài hái méi kàndào tā.
lines.english: I'm waiting for my roommate. Half an hour ago he said he was almost here, but I still haven't seen him.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 他會不會走錯地方了？很多人以為表演在大禮堂，其實是在這個小禮堂。
lines.simplified: 他会不会走错地方了？很多人以为表演在大礼堂，其实是在这个小礼堂。
lines.pinyin: Tā huì bú huì zǒu cuò dìfāng le? Hěn duō rén yǐwéi biǎoyǎn zài dà lǐtáng, qíshí shì zài zhège xiǎo lǐtáng.
lines.english: Could he have gone to the wrong place? Lots of people think the show is in the big auditorium, but it is in this small hall.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 有可能。我打電話叫他過來，妳先進去，幫我們留兩個位子吧。
lines.simplified: 有可能。我打电话叫他过来，你先进去，帮我们留两个位子吧。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu kěnéng. Wǒ dǎ diànhuà jiào tā guòlái, nǐ xiān jìnqù, bāng wǒmen liú liǎng ge wèizi ba.
lines.english: Could be. I'll call him over. You go in first and keep two seats for us.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 好，我坐在前面，你們進來就看得到我。
lines.simplified: 好，我坐在前面，你们进来就看得到我。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ zuò zài qiánmiàn, nǐmen jìnlái jiù kàn de dào wǒ.
lines.english: OK, I'll sit at the front. You'll see me as soon as you come in.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的為什麼在門口走來走去？
prompt.simplified: 男的为什么在门口走来走去？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de wèishénme zài ménkǒu zǒu lái zǒu qù?
prompt.english: Why is the man pacing at the door?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He is looking for the small hall.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He is waiting for someone to come.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He is waiting for the show to start.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: He went to the wrong place.

questions.why: 走來走去 is the restless walking of someone waiting: his roommate said he was almost there half an hour ago and still hasn't come. He is already at the small hall, the show has already started, and the wrong place is only her guess about the roommate.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的會坐在哪裡？
prompt.simplified: 女的会坐在哪里？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de huì zuò zài nǎlǐ?
prompt.english: Where will the woman sit?

questions.why: 我坐在前面，你們進來就看得到我: she will sit at the front so they can see her when they come in. The door is where the man waits, not where she sits.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段對話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段对话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn duìhuà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a conversation, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 我的笛子不見了！明天就要表演了，我在房間裡找來找去，都找不到。
lines.simplified: 我的笛子不见了！明天就要表演了，我在房间里找来找去，都找不到。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ de dízi bújiàn le! Míngtiān jiù yào biǎoyǎn le, wǒ zài fángjiān lǐ zhǎo lái zhǎo qù, dōu zhǎo bú dào.
lines.english: My flute is gone! The show is tomorrow, and I've searched my whole room and can't find it.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 別著急。你最後一次吹是什麼時候？
lines.simplified: 别着急。你最后一次吹是什么时候？
lines.pinyin: Bié zhāojí. Nǐ zuìhòu yí cì chuī shì shénme shíhòu?
lines.english: Don't worry. When did you last play it?

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 昨天下午在禮堂練習的時候。練習完，我就跟同學去餐廳吃飯了。
lines.simplified: 昨天下午在礼堂练习的时候。练习完，我就跟同学去餐厅吃饭了。
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān xiàwǔ zài lǐtáng liànxí de shíhòu. Liànxí wán, wǒ jiù gēn tóngxué qù cāntīng chīfàn le.
lines.english: Yesterday afternoon, at practice in the auditorium. After practice I went to a restaurant with classmates.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 那可能是放在禮堂裡忘了拿。我等一下要去禮堂幫老師準備明天的會場，我替你找找看。
lines.simplified: 那可能是放在礼堂里忘了拿。我等一下要去礼堂帮老师准备明天的会场，我替你找找看。
lines.pinyin: Nà kěnéng shì fàng zài lǐtáng lǐ wàng le ná. Wǒ děng yíxià yào qù lǐtáng bāng lǎoshī zhǔnbèi míngtiān de huìchǎng, wǒ tì nǐ zhǎozhǎo kàn.
lines.english: Then you probably left it in the auditorium. I'm going there soon to help the teacher get tomorrow's venue ready; I'll have a look for you.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 太好了！找到了請打電話給我。
lines.simplified: 太好了！找到了请打电话给我。
lines.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Zhǎo dào le qǐng dǎ diànhuà gěi wǒ.
lines.english: Great! Please call me if you find it.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 男的在房間裡做了什麼？
prompt.simplified: 男的在房间里做了什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nán de zài fángjiān lǐ zuò le shénme?
prompt.english: What did the man do in his room?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Practised the flute the whole time.

questions.why: 找來找去 means he searched all over his room and still couldn't find the flute. He practised in the auditorium yesterday, not in his room, and the call he mentions is the one he hopes she will make.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 女的等一下要做什麼？
prompt.simplified: 女的等一下要做什么？
prompt.pinyin: Nǚ de děng yíxià yào zuò shénme?
prompt.english: What is the woman going to do soon?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Go to eat with the man.

questions.why: 我等一下要去禮堂幫老師準備明天的會場: she is going to the auditorium to help the teacher set up. Eating with classmates is what the man did yesterday.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段話，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段话，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn huà, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a short talk, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 大家好，歡迎來參加世界文化日！今天禮堂外面有二十幾個國家的攤子，可以嚐到各國的小吃，還可以穿傳統服裝照相，照一次五十塊。
lines.simplified: 大家好，欢迎来参加世界文化日！今天礼堂外面有二十几个国家的摊子，可以尝到各国的小吃，还可以穿传统服装照相，照一次五十块。
lines.pinyin: Dàjiā hǎo, huānyíng lái cānjiā Shìjiè Wénhuàrì! Jīntiān lǐtáng wàimiàn yǒu èrshí jǐ ge guójiā de tānzi, kěyǐ cháng dào gè guó de xiǎochī, hái kěyǐ chuān chuántǒng fúzhuāng zhàoxiàng, zhào yí cì wǔshí kuài.
lines.english: Hello everyone, and welcome to World Culture Day! Today there are stalls from over twenty countries outside the auditorium. You can taste snacks from every country, and you can take photos in traditional clothes, fifty dollars a photo.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 小吃是免費的，不過只有拿到小卡片的人，才能嚐。卡片放在門口的桌子上，一個人拿一張。
lines.simplified: 小吃是免费的，不过只有拿到小卡片的人，才能尝。卡片放在门口的桌子上，一个人拿一张。
lines.pinyin: Xiǎochī shì miǎnfèi de, búguò zhǐyǒu ná dào xiǎo kǎpiàn de rén, cái néng cháng. Kǎpiàn fàng zài ménkǒu de zhuōzi shàng, yí ge rén ná yì zhāng.
lines.english: The snacks are free, but only people with a small card can taste them. The cards are on the table by the door; one per person.

lines.speaker: M
lines.traditional: 還有，下午一點，校長會親自來看表演，表演結束以後，他要跟大家一起照相。
lines.simplified: 还有，下午一点，校长会亲自来看表演，表演结束以后，他要跟大家一起照相。
lines.pinyin: Háiyǒu, xiàwǔ yī diǎn, xiàozhǎng huì qīnzì lái kàn biǎoyǎn, biǎoyǎn jiéshù yǐhòu, tā yào gēn dàjiā yìqǐ zhàoxiàng.
lines.english: Also, at one this afternoon the principal will come in person to watch the shows, and after the shows he will take photos with everyone.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 想嚐各國的小吃，要怎麼做？
prompt.simplified: 想尝各国的小吃，要怎么做？
prompt.pinyin: Xiǎng cháng gè guó de xiǎochī, yào zěnme zuò?
prompt.english: What must you do to taste the countries' snacks?

questions.why: 只有拿到小卡片的人，才能嚐: the card is the condition, and the snacks themselves are free. Fifty dollars is the price of a photo in traditional clothes.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 下午一點會發生什麼事？
prompt.simplified: 下午一点会发生什么事？
prompt.pinyin: Xiàwǔ yī diǎn huì fāshēng shénme shì?
prompt.english: What will happen at one in the afternoon?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The principal comes to the venue.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Everyone takes photos with the principal.

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: The shows are about to end.

questions.why: 下午一點，校長會親自來看表演: at one the principal comes in person. The photos with him come after the shows end, not at one.

intro.speaker: N
intro.traditional: 請聽一段留言，然後回答兩個問題。
intro.simplified: 请听一段留言，然后回答两个问题。
intro.pinyin: Qǐng tīng yí duàn liúyán, ránhòu huídá liǎng ge wèntí.
intro.english: Listen to a voice message, then answer two questions.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 你好，我是功夫社團的教練。下個月學校要在大禮堂舉辦社團表演，我們社團也要上去表演。
lines.simplified: 你好，我是功夫社团的教练。下个月学校要在大礼堂举办社团表演，我们社团也要上去表演。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo, wǒ shì gōngfu shètuán de jiàoliàn. Xià ge yuè xuéxiào yào zài dà lǐtáng jǔbàn shètuán biǎoyǎn, wǒmen shètuán yě yào shàngqù biǎoyǎn.
lines.english: Hello, this is the coach of the kung fu club. Next month the school is holding a club show in the big auditorium, and our club will perform too.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 我們本來每個星期一晚上八點練習，這個星期改到星期四晚上七點，地點還是在操場。
lines.simplified: 我们本来每个星期一晚上八点练习，这个星期改到星期四晚上七点，地点还是在操场。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen běnlái měi ge xīngqíyī wǎnshàng bā diǎn liànxí, zhège xīngqí gǎi dào xīngqísì wǎnshàng qī diǎn, dìdiǎn háishì zài cāochǎng.
lines.english: We usually practise every Monday at eight p.m.; this week it moves to Thursday at seven p.m., still on the sports field.

lines.speaker: F
lines.traditional: 表演只有十分鐘，上去表演的人不能太多，只有每次都來練習的人，才可以上去，所以請你一定要來。謝謝！
lines.simplified: 表演只有十分钟，上去表演的人不能太多，只有每次都来练习的人，才可以上去，所以请你一定要来。谢谢！
lines.pinyin: Biǎoyǎn zhǐyǒu shí fēnzhōng, shàngqù biǎoyǎn de rén bù néng tài duō, zhǐyǒu měi cì dōu lái liànxí de rén, cái kěyǐ shàngqù, suǒyǐ qǐng nǐ yídìng yào lái. Xièxie!
lines.english: The show is only ten minutes, so not too many people can perform: only those who come to every practice can go up, so please be sure to come. Thanks!

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 這個星期他們什麼時候練習？
prompt.simplified: 这个星期他们什么时候练习？
prompt.pinyin: Zhège xīngqí tāmen shénme shíhòu liànxí?
prompt.english: When do they practise this week?

questions.why: 這個星期改到星期四晚上七點: this week's practice moves to Thursday at seven. Monday at eight is the usual time, which this week does not use.

prompt.speaker: N
prompt.traditional: 什麼人才可以上去表演？
prompt.simplified: 什么人才可以上去表演？
prompt.pinyin: Shénme rén cái kěyǐ shàngqù biǎoyǎn?
prompt.english: Who can go up and perform?

choices.speaker: N
choices.english: Those whose kung fu is best.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Měi cì liànxí dōu dào de rén.

choices.speaker: N
choices.pinyin: Shètuán lǐ de měi ge rén.

questions.why: 只有每次都來練習的人，才可以上去: coming to every practice is the condition. The club performs, but not every member; the coach never says she picks people or that the best go up.

text.traditional:
華語文中心邀請所有老師、同學來參加！
時間：12月5日 11:00–15:00
地點：學校大禮堂
內容：各國同學表演唱歌、跳舞；禮堂外面也有各國的攤子，介紹自己國家的風俗習慣，像傳統服裝、玩具、小吃等等。

prompt.traditional: 教大家做甜點的活動，幾點開始？在哪裡？

prompt.traditional: 一位同學下午一點才能到會場，他最先看到的是哪一個表演？

passage.traditional: 來台灣以前，我聽說台灣的小吃很多，像雞排、滷肉飯、蚵仔煎{1}，都很有名。第一次跟朋友逛夜市，我看到蚵仔煎上面紅紅的，以為很辣，一口也不敢{2}。台灣朋友笑著說：「你覺得它辣？它好吃{3}呢！」後來我試了一口，才發現它一點也不辣，還有點甜。現在我覺得蚵仔煎最好吃，大餐廳的菜都{4}它。我也明白了，{5}自己嚐過，才知道好不好吃。
passage.simplified: 来台湾以前，我听说台湾的小吃很多，像鸡排、卤肉饭、蚵仔煎{1}，都很有名。第一次跟朋友逛夜市，我看到蚵仔煎上面红红的，以为很辣，一口也不敢{2}。台湾朋友笑着说：「你觉得它辣？它好吃{3}呢！」后来我试了一口，才发现它一点也不辣，还有点甜。现在我觉得蚵仔煎最好吃，大餐厅的菜都{4}它。我也明白了，{5}自己尝过，才知道好不好吃。
passage.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐqián, wǒ tīngshuō Táiwān de xiǎochī hěn duō, xiàng jīpái, lǔròu fàn, ézǐjiān shénme de, dōu hěn yǒumíng. Dì yī cì gēn péngyǒu guàng yèshì, wǒ kàndào ézǐjiān shàngmiàn hónghóng de, yǐwéi hěn là, yì kǒu yě bù gǎn cháng. Táiwān péngyǒu xiào zhe shuō: “Nǐ juéde tā là? Tā hǎochī dehěn ne!” Hòulái wǒ shì le yì kǒu, cái fāxiàn tā yìdiǎn yě bú là, hái yǒudiǎn tián. Xiànzài wǒ juéde ézǐjiān zuì hǎochī, dà cāntīng de cài dōu bǐ bú shàng tā. Wǒ yě míngbái le, zhǐyǒu zìjǐ cháng guo, cái zhīdào hǎo bù hǎochī.
passage.english: Before I came to Taiwan, I heard it had lots of street food, such as chicken cutlets, braised pork rice, oyster omelets and so on, all very famous. The first time I went to a night market with friends, I saw the red sauce on the oyster omelet, thought it was spicy, and didn't dare taste a single bite. My Taiwanese friend laughed, “You think it's spicy? It's really delicious!” Later I tried a bite and found it wasn't spicy at all, even a bit sweet. Now I think oyster omelets are the best; no big restaurant's dishes can compare with it. I've also learned that only by tasting something yourself do you know whether it tastes good.

questions.why: 像雞排、滷肉飯、蚵仔煎什麼的: 像 + a few examples + 什麼的 means 'such as … and so on'. 怎麼樣, 為什麼 and 怎麼了 are questions and can't close a list.
一口也不敢嚐: the writer didn't dare taste a single bite. 一口 goes with eating or tasting; an omelet is not drunk, and 一口也不敢聞／看 don't fit a bite.
好吃得很 disagrees with 'it's spicy': it is very tasty. The others need more around them: 好吃極了, 好吃得不得了, 很好吃.
The oyster omelet is the best (最好吃), so restaurant dishes 比不上 it: can't compare. 比得上 would say they are just as good, and 比較它／比起來它 aren't Chinese.
只有自己嚐過，才知道: only by tasting yourself do you know. 只有 pairs with 才; 不管 pairs with 都, 雖然 with 可是, and 而且 adds a point rather than a condition.

passage.traditional: 我的室友是越南人，他的個性很{1}，所以常常說笑話給大家聽。上個週末是他的生日，他媽媽從越南來看他，還親自做了很多越南小吃，像米粉、越南麵包{2}。吃完飯，大家想去唱歌，我們在網路上看來{3}，最後選了學校附近的一家KTV。我的室友唱歌唱得好極了，我們幾個人裡面，沒有人{4}他。大家玩得很開心，都說下次還要再去。不過什麼時候去，{5}大家有沒有空。
passage.simplified: 我的室友是越南人，他的个性很{1}，所以常常说笑话给大家听。上个周末是他的生日，他妈妈从越南来看他，还亲自做了很多越南小吃，像米粉、越南面包{2}。吃完饭，大家想去唱歌，我们在网路上看来{3}，最后选了学校附近的一家KTV。我的室友唱歌唱得好极了，我们几个人里面，没有人{4}他。大家玩得很开心，都说下次还要再去。不过什么时候去，{5}大家有没有空。
passage.pinyin: Wǒ de shìyǒu shì Yuènán rén, tā de gèxìng hěn huópō, suǒyǐ chángcháng shuō xiàohuà gěi dàjiā tīng. Shàng ge zhōumò shì tā de shēngrì, tā māma cóng Yuènán lái kàn tā, hái qīnzì zuò le hěn duō Yuènán xiǎochī, xiàng mǐfěn, Yuènán miànbāo shénme de. Chī wán fàn, dàjiā xiǎng qù chànggē, wǒmen zài wǎnglù shàng kàn lái kàn qù, zuìhòu xuǎn le xuéxiào fùjìn de yì jiā KTV. Wǒ de shìyǒu chànggē chàng de hǎo jíle, wǒmen jǐ ge rén lǐmiàn, méiyǒu rén bǐ de shàng tā. Dàjiā wán de hěn kāixīn, dōu shuō xià cì hái yào zài qù. Búguò shénme shíhòu qù, yào kàn dàjiā yǒu méiyǒu kòng.
passage.english: My roommate is Vietnamese. He's lively, so he often tells everyone jokes. Last weekend was his birthday; his mother came from Vietnam to see him and made lots of Vietnamese snacks herself, such as rice noodles, Vietnamese bread rolls and so on. After dinner we wanted to sing, so we looked around online again and again and finally chose a KTV near school. My roommate sings brilliantly; none of us can match him. Everyone had a great time and said we must go again. But when we go depends on whether everyone is free.

questions.why: 所以常常說笑話給大家聽: telling everyone jokes follows from a lively personality. Being shy, quiet or conservative would not be the reason for that.
像米粉、越南麵包什麼的: 像 + examples + 什麼的 closes a list of examples. The other three are questions.
看來看去，最後選了: V來V去 means doing it over and over before deciding. 看來看到／看完／看好 aren't patterns.
He sings brilliantly (好極了), so nobody can match him: 沒有人比得上他. 沒有人比不上他 and 沒有人不如他 would mean everyone is at least as good as he is.
什麼時候去，要看大家有沒有空: when they go depends on whether everyone is free. 看起來, 看得出 and 看到 can't introduce a 有沒有 condition.

text.traditional: 去年學校舉辦世界文化日，我們班的越南同學做了一部影片，介紹越南的風俗習慣。我們花了兩個星期，每天晚上都在宿舍做到很晚。大家都覺得影片做得很好，別的攤子一定比不上。誰知道文化日那天，旁邊攤子的荷蘭同學一邊教大家做鬆餅，一邊請大家嚐，攤子前面站滿了人；我們的攤子，一個上午只來了五個人。下午，校長親自來看了我們的影片，還跟大家說他也想去越南看看。後來，很多人都過來看了。我這才明白，東西做得好還不夠，還得讓大家知道。
text.simplified: 去年学校举办世界文化日，我们班的越南同学做了一部影片，介绍越南的风俗习惯。我们花了两个星期，每天晚上都在宿舍做到很晚。大家都觉得影片做得很好，别的摊子一定比不上。谁知道文化日那天，旁边摊子的荷兰同学一边教大家做松饼，一边请大家尝，摊子前面站满了人；我们的摊子，一个上午只来了五个人。下午，校长亲自来看了我们的影片，还跟大家说他也想去越南看看。后来，很多人都过来看了。我这才明白，东西做得好还不够，还得让大家知道。
text.pinyin: Qùnián xuéxiào jǔbàn Shìjiè Wénhuàrì, wǒmen bān de Yuènán tóngxué zuò le yí bù yǐngpiàn, jièshào Yuènán de fēngsú xíguàn. Wǒmen huā le liǎng ge xīngqí, měi tiān wǎnshàng dōu zài sùshè zuò dào hěn wǎn. Dàjiā dōu juéde yǐngpiàn zuò de hěn hǎo, bié de tānzi yídìng bǐ bú shàng. Shéi zhīdào Wénhuàrì nà tiān, pángbiān tānzi de Hélán tóngxué yìbiān jiāo dàjiā zuò sōngbǐng, yìbiān qǐng dàjiā cháng, tānzi qiánmiàn zhàn mǎn le rén; wǒmen de tānzi, yí ge shàngwǔ zhǐ lái le wǔ ge rén. Xiàwǔ, xiàozhǎng qīnzì lái kàn le wǒmen de yǐngpiàn, hái gēn dàjiā shuō tā yě xiǎng qù Yuènán kànkàn. Hòulái, hěn duō rén dōu guòlái kàn le. Wǒ zhè cái míngbái, dōngxi zuò de hǎo hái bú gòu, hái děi ràng dàjiā zhīdào.
text.english: Last year the school held World Culture Day, and the Vietnamese students in our class made a video about Vietnamese customs. We spent two weeks on it, working late in the dorm every night. We all thought the video was so good that no other stall could compare. Who knew that on the day the Dutch students at the next stall would teach everyone to make waffles and let them taste, with people crowding in front of their stall, while all morning only five people came to ours? In the afternoon the principal came in person to watch our video and told everyone he wanted to visit Vietnam too. After that, lots of people came over to watch. Only then did I understand: making something good isn't enough; you also have to let people know about it.

text.traditional: 我小時候住在鄉下，家裡沒有多少錢，買不起玩具。爺爺就常常用竹子替我做玩具，像小船、笛子什麼的。他一邊做，一邊說以前的故事給我聽，我在旁邊看，慢慢地也學會了自己做。現在的孩子有各式各樣的玩具，很多孩子連平板、手機都用得很好，可是我覺得，那些新玩具都比不上爺爺做的。因為爺爺的玩具不但好玩，還讓我學會了很多東西，也讓我跟爺爺的關係更好。去年我有了孩子，我也開始用竹子給他做玩具了。
text.simplified: 我小时候住在乡下，家里没有多少钱，买不起玩具。爷爷就常常用竹子替我做玩具，像小船、笛子什么的。他一边做，一边说以前的故事给我听，我在旁边看，慢慢地也学会了自己做。现在的孩子有各式各样的玩具，很多孩子连平板、手机都用得很好，可是我觉得，那些新玩具都比不上爷爷做的。因为爷爷的玩具不但好玩，还让我学会了很多东西，也让我跟爷爷的关系更好。去年我有了孩子，我也开始用竹子给他做玩具了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎoshíhòu zhù zài xiāngxià, jiā lǐ méiyǒu duōshǎo qián, mǎi bù qǐ wánjù. Yéye jiù chángcháng yòng zhúzi tì wǒ zuò wánjù, xiàng xiǎo chuán, dízi shénme de. Tā yìbiān zuò, yìbiān shuō yǐqián de gùshì gěi wǒ tīng, wǒ zài pángbiān kàn, mànmàn de yě xuéhuì le zìjǐ zuò. Xiànzài de háizi yǒu gèshìgèyàng de wánjù, hěn duō háizi lián píngbǎn, shǒujī dōu yòng de hěn hǎo, kěshì wǒ juéde, nàxiē xīn wánjù dōu bǐ bú shàng yéye zuò de. Yīnwèi yéye de wánjù búdàn hǎowán, hái ràng wǒ xuéhuì le hěn duō dōngxi, yě ràng wǒ gēn yéye de guānxì gèng hǎo. Qùnián wǒ yǒu le háizi, wǒ yě kāishǐ yòng zhúzi gěi tā zuò wánjù le.
text.english: As a child I lived in the countryside. My family didn't have much money and couldn't afford toys, so Grandpa often made me toys from bamboo, such as little boats, flutes and so on. While he made them he told me stories from the old days; I watched beside him and slowly learned to make them myself. Children today have all kinds of toys, and many can even use tablets and phones well, but I think none of those new toys can compare with the ones Grandpa made. His toys were not only fun, they also taught me a lot and brought me closer to Grandpa. Last year I had a child, and I've started making bamboo toys for that child too.

title.english: I fell in love with swimming

text.traditional: 我以前覺得運動很無聊，下了課只想在宿舍上網、看影片，常常很晚才睡，三餐也不正常。去年冬天，我感冒了一個多月，醫生說我的體力太差，建議我每天運動。從那天起，我就每天早上去學校的游泳池游泳。剛開始，我游泳不到五分鐘就累死了，可是學校的教練說，只要每天游泳，就會越練習越輕鬆。現在，不管是冷天還是下雨天，我都會去游泳，每次半個小時。半年以後，我不但很少生病，上課也比以前有精神了。
text.simplified: 我以前觉得运动很无聊，下了课只想在宿舍上网、看影片，常常很晚才睡，三餐也不正常。去年冬天，我感冒了一个多月，医生说我的体力太差，建议我每天运动。从那天起，我就每天早上去学校的游泳池游泳。刚开始，我游泳不到五分钟就累死了，可是学校的教练说，只要每天游泳，就会越练习越轻松。现在，不管是冷天还是下雨天，我都会去游泳，每次半个小时。半年以后，我不但很少生病，上课也比以前有精神了。
text.pinyin: Wǒ yǐqián juéde yùndòng hěn wúliáo, xià le kè zhǐ xiǎng zài sùshè shàngwǎng, kàn yǐngpiàn, chángcháng hěn wǎn cái shuì, sāncān yě bú zhèngcháng. Qùnián dōngtiān, wǒ gǎnmào le yí ge duō yuè, yīshēng shuō wǒ de tǐlì tài chà, jiànyì wǒ měi tiān yùndòng. Cóng nà tiān qǐ, wǒ jiù měi tiān zǎoshàng qù xuéxiào de yóuyǒngchí yóuyǒng. Gāng kāishǐ, wǒ yóuyǒng bú dào wǔ fēnzhōng jiù lèi sǐ le, kěshì xuéxiào de jiàoliàn shuō, zhǐyào měi tiān yóuyǒng, jiù huì yuè liànxí yuè qīngsōng. Xiànzài, bùguǎn shì lěng tiān háishì xiàyǔ tiān, wǒ dōu huì qù yóuyǒng, měi cì bàn ge xiǎoshí. Bàn nián yǐhòu, wǒ búdàn hěn shǎo shēngbìng, shàngkè yě bǐ yǐqián yǒu jīngshén le.
text.english: I used to find exercise boring. After class I only wanted to surf the internet and watch videos in the dorm; I often went to bed very late, and my meals were irregular. Last winter I had a cold for over a month. The doctor said my stamina was too poor and suggested I exercise every day. From that day on, I've swum in the school pool every morning. At first I was exhausted in under five minutes, but the school coach said that if I swam every day, it would get easier and easier. Now, whether it's cold or raining, I go and swim for half an hour. Six months on, I hardly ever get sick, and I'm more awake in class than before.

prompt.traditional: 寫這篇文章的人是什麼時候開始每天運動的？
prompt.simplified: 写这篇文章的人是什么时候开始每天运动的？
prompt.pinyin: Xiě zhè piān wénzhāng de rén shì shénme shíhòu kāishǐ měi tiān yùndòng de?

prompt.traditional: 教練的意思是什麼？

title.english: Teachers' Day at the Confucius Temple

text.traditional: 九月二十八號是教師節，那天學校放假。早上我的韓國朋友打電話來，說她想起來那天也是孔子的生日，問我要不要去孔廟看看。我說：「好啊，說走就走！」我們本來以為那麼早，孔廟裡的人不會太多，誰知道一到那裡，就看到很多父母帶著孩子來拜拜，希望孩子念書念得好。一位老先生跟我們說了孔子的故事，他說，以前只有有錢人才能念書，可是孔子不管學生有沒有錢，都願意教他們。回到宿舍以後，我把聽到的故事都記下來，寫了一篇作文。
text.simplified: 九月二十八号是教师节，那天学校放假。早上我的韩国朋友打电话来，说她想起来那天也是孔子的生日，问我要不要去孔庙看看。我说：「好啊，说走就走！」我们本来以为那么早，孔庙里的人不会太多，谁知道一到那里，就看到很多父母带着孩子来拜拜，希望孩子念书念得好。一位老先生跟我们说了孔子的故事，他说，以前只有有钱人才能念书，可是孔子不管学生有没有钱，都愿意教他们。回到宿舍以后，我把听到的故事都记下来，写了一篇作文。
text.pinyin: Jiǔ yuè èrshíbā hào shì Jiàoshījié, nà tiān xuéxiào fàngjià. Zǎoshàng wǒ de Hánguó péngyǒu dǎ diànhuà lái, shuō tā xiǎng qǐlái nà tiān yě shì Kǒngzǐ de shēngrì, wèn wǒ yào bú yào qù Kǒngmiào kànkàn. Wǒ shuō: “Hǎo a, shuō zǒu jiù zǒu!” Wǒmen běnlái yǐwéi nàme zǎo, Kǒngmiào lǐ de rén bú huì tài duō, shéi zhīdào yí dào nàlǐ, jiù kàndào hěn duō fùmǔ dài zhe háizi lái bàibài, xīwàng háizi niànshū niàn de hǎo. Yí wèi lǎo xiānshēng gēn wǒmen shuō le Kǒngzǐ de gùshì, tā shuō, yǐqián zhǐyǒu yǒu qián rén cái néng niànshū, kěshì Kǒngzǐ bùguǎn xuéshēng yǒu méiyǒu qián, dōu yuànyì jiāo tāmen. Huí dào sùshè yǐhòu, wǒ bǎ tīngdào de gùshì dōu jì xiàlái, xiě le yì piān zuòwén.
text.english: September 28 is Teachers' Day, and the school had the day off. In the morning my Korean friend called: she had remembered it was also Confucius's birthday and asked if I wanted to visit the Confucius Temple. I said, “Sure, let's go right now!” We thought it would be quiet that early, but as soon as we got there we saw lots of parents who had brought their children to pray that they would do well at school. An old man told us stories about Confucius. He said that in the old days only rich people could study, but Confucius was willing to teach students whether or not they had money. Back at the dorm, I wrote down the stories I had heard and wrote a composition.
